basis: Primary source conditions and bounded cases; potential contributions are hypotheses to test in context.

records.response: Retain the arrangement and improve a process/control
records.when_to_consider: Required capability is adequate; source, cutoff, authority or exception ownership is unclear. No immediate purchase can also be reasonable if current outcomes are adequate or a prerequisite is unresolved.
records.potential_contribution_to_test: Change the specific handoff without replacing functioning components.
records.retained_work_and_verification: Complete authorised inputs, actual control operation, consequence closure and a responsible review point.
records.conditions_and_work_to_assess: An owner needs real authority/capacity; an instruction alone may not change behaviour or an external dependency. Reconsideration needs a reason and trigger.

records.when_to_consider: A required function exists but configuration, entitlement, permissions, training or scope is the gap.
records.potential_contribution_to_test: Use existing capability for the relevant control/workflow.
records.retained_work_and_verification: Rules/effective dates, exceptions, appropriate roles, current package and reconciled output.
records.conditions_and_work_to_assess: Configuration and updates need testing; added modules/support can have limits or charges. Sample rules are a starting point, not a complete employer configuration.

records.when_to_consider: Repeated transfer, mapping or a defined information gap is material.
records.potential_contribution_to_test: Reduce a particular transfer task or provide useful timely information.
records.retained_work_and_verification: Source correctness/authority, partial acceptance, downstream reconciliation, actual decision use and external corrections.
records.conditions_and_work_to_assess: Agree source/blank semantics, IDs, periods, access, job/error monitoring and recovery. A connector can transfer incomplete/wrong data faithfully.

records.response: Add analytical or AI assistance to a defined task
records.when_to_consider: Exception investigation or information explanation has a bounded task and a credible review path.
records.potential_contribution_to_test: Help locate, explain or work through a relevant issue.
records.retained_work_and_verification: Actual actions allowed, material decisions, output correctness, unresolved cases, update effects and result assessment.
records.evidence_hooks: CLM-0229–0234. No numerical savings or uniform adoption claim.
records.conditions_and_work_to_assess: Verify product/territory entitlement, source quality, permissions, test coverage, meaningful intervention and ongoing support. Review effort may offset time released.

records.response: Replace or modernise the core platform
records.when_to_consider: An evaluated fit, lifecycle or foundation limitation remains; smaller changes may be insufficient.
records.potential_contribution_to_test: Provide a different operating foundation or required capability.
records.retained_work_and_verification: Useful pay/records/reporting, authorised release, stable support, retained expertise, defined change outputs/acceptance and evidence of the intended result.
records.evidence_hooks: CLM-0213, CLM-0223–0228, CLM-0245–0247. Case/scope context, not comparative vendor efficacy.
records.conditions_and_work_to_assess: Migration/IDs, configuration, interfaces, training, cutover, recovery and live workload need capacity. New modules may not yet deliver the intended information.

records.when_to_consider: Specific recurring execution or cover requirements can be contracted clearly.
records.potential_contribution_to_test: Access execution capacity or expertise under a defined arrangement.
records.retained_work_and_verification: Actual entitlement, handoff acceptance, authorisation, bank/reporting result, escalation and closure.
records.conditions_and_work_to_assess: Employer inputs, checking, approval, policy and oversight can remain. Processing, payment and employee-query duties require separate scope.

records.when_to_consider: One part of the cycle needs support while other work is appropriately retained.
records.potential_contribution_to_test: Target a constraint without assuming wholesale delegation.
records.retained_work_and_verification: End-to-end result across all components/partners, data access, actual engagement outputs, support boundaries, continuity and handback/exit.
records.conditions_and_work_to_assess: More interfaces can omit or duplicate tasks; shared definitions, authority, acceptance and recovery need owners.

records.response: Strengthen expertise, operating cover or leadership
records.when_to_consider: Absence, change work or an enduring/time-bound skill or authority gap is material.
records.potential_contribution_to_test: Cover, develop or lead the relevant work while preserving operating knowledge.
records.retained_work_and_verification: Defined tasks/work products, who judges completion, retained operations, quality, continuity, knowledge/ownership and handback where relevant.
records.evidence_hooks: CLM-0222, CLM-0245–0248 plus R02 capacity contexts. No inference of a shortage or need to hire.
records.conditions_and_work_to_assess: Duration, tasks, access, competence/context, authority and quality review must fit. Individual capacity/advice, project delivery and ongoing execution have different obligations.

cross_cutting_conditions.what_to_establish: Product/module/package, country/entity, worker relationship, task, actual executor and included access/support. A global brand or country count is insufficient.
cross_cutting_conditions.evidence_hooks_and_limits: CLM-0241–0243. Employment-provider, HR-record, payroll and payment services are distinct; no new employment-advice path.

cross_cutting_conditions.what_to_establish: Originator, employee/manager approval, operator, beneficiary and support. Distinguish onboarding from recurring work; assess the result rather than assume net savings or burden.
cross_cutting_conditions.evidence_hooks_and_limits: CLM-0240, CLM-0243. Supplier self-service scope is not measured effort or user acceptance.

cross_cutting_conditions.what_to_establish: Applicable changes, responsible owner, relevant checks, communication and exception/recovery route. Separate transition, ordinary cycle, scheduled updates and exceptional changes.
cross_cutting_conditions.evidence_hooks_and_limits: CLM-0235–0239, CLM-0249, CLM-0251. Product-specific release cadence and public guidance are not universal schedules or private procurement mandates.

cross_cutting_conditions.what_to_establish: Individual capacity, enduring leadership, employer-directed work, consulting-led outputs or continuing service. Define work product, who judges completion, retained authority and knowledge handback.
cross_cutting_conditions.evidence_hooks_and_limits: CLM-0245–0248. Declared engagement models are not a signed payroll contract or demonstrated outcome.

cross_cutting_conditions.what_to_establish: Appropriate access, records/configuration/knowledge and an operable recovery/receiving route. Balance useful delegated capability against accepted dependence.
cross_cutting_conditions.evidence_hooks_and_limits: CLM-0250–0252. Export/backup is not a tested restored service; technical dependence is not automatically harmful or a measured switching cost.
